dedupe_keys.name: coudlabs wp8 t812 eawag 001 sediment depth measurements for surrogate modeling of sediment build up in gully pots using temperature data

description: Fuchs, Lenard at Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology publishes sediment-depth measurements supporting temperature-based gully-pot surrogate models through Co-UDlabs. The native title identifies the measurement and modelling role, while the description ties the campaign to an ETH Zurich environmental-engineering thesis on automated sediment-accumulation estimation. Data and code archives are distinct components of the same study. Coverage is the Eawag campaign in Switzerland; detailed locations, dates and sample resolution are not described. Zenodo provides DATA and CODES ZIP archives plus a PDF report with free access under CC BY-NC 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the thesis and archives were not read, so model coefficients, code execution and ground-truth measurement accuracy remain unverified. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
